prep
```{r}
# packages
library(ranger)
library(tidyverse)

# --- DYNAMIC PATH CONFIGURATION ---
if (!exists("base_dir")) {
  base_dir <- getwd()
}

data_path <- file.path(base_dir, "data", "SEFM_events_94_24_matching_complete_01JUN2026.csv")
erc_path  <- file.path(base_dir, "data", "fire_erc_percentiles.csv")

# 1. Load Datasets and Join
data <- read.csv(data_path)
erc  <- read.csv(erc_path)

unique(data_erc$classification)
str(data_erc)

# Convert categorical text/numeric codes into distinct categories (factors)
data_erc$classification <- as.factor(data_erc$classification)
data_erc$ecol3_mode     <- as.factor(data_erc$ecol3_mode)
data_erc$nlcdr_mode     <- as.factor(data_erc$nlcdr_mode)

# 2. Ensure numeric columns are correctly typed
data_erc$midpoint_month <- as.integer(data_erc$midpoint_month)
data_erc$SUM_area_ha    <- as.numeric(data_erc$SUM_area_ha)
data_erc$year_mode <- as.numeric(data_erc$year_mode)
data_erc$absolute_mean_erc <- as.numeric(data_erc$absolute_mean_erc)
data_erc$totality_percentile <- as.numeric(data_erc$totality_percentile)

# Round ercs to 2 decimal places
data_erc$absolute_mean_erc <- round(data_erc$absolute_mean_erc, digits = 2)
data_erc$totality_percentile <- round(data_erc$totality_percentile, digits = 2)

# Create the record_match column (1 if it has a label, 0 if it's empty)
data_erc$record_match <- 
  ifelse(data_erc$classification %in% c("wildfire", "prescribed"), 1, 0)

# Verify that the new column populated correctly
table(data_erc$record_match, useNA = "always")

# Isolate the matched records (where record_match is 1)
matched_pool <- data_erc %>% 
  filter(record_match == 1)
str(matched_pool)

# Drop any empty ghost levels from the factor columns
matched_pool <- droplevels(matched_pool)

# Verify that classification now only has 2 levels
levels(matched_pool$classification)
```

train/validation split
```{r}
# 1. Set a random seed so this exact split can be reproduced later
set.seed(42)

# 2. Calculate the number of rows that make up 80% of the data
train_size <- floor(0.80 * nrow(matched_pool))

# 3. Randomly select the row indices for the training set
train_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(matched_pool)), size = train_size)

# 4. Separate the data into two distinct data frames
train_set <- matched_pool[train_indices, ]
valid_set <- matched_pool[-train_indices, ]

# 5. Print out the final row counts to verify
cat("Training set rows:", nrow(train_set), "\n")
cat("Validation set rows:", nrow(valid_set), "\n")
```

ClassiFIRE. 
```{r}
library(ranger)

# --- 1. FIT RANGER PROBABILITY MODEL ---
rf_model_v7_prob <- ranger(
  formula         = classification ~ SUM_area_ha + ecol3_mode + nlcdr_mode + 
                    midpoint_month + absolute_mean_erc + totality_percentile,
  data            = train_set,
  num.trees       = 500,
  importance      = "impurity",
  probability     = TRUE,
  verbose         = TRUE,
  mtry            = 4
)

print(rf_model_v7_prob)

# --- 2. VALIDATION SET PREDICTIONS ---
# Extract predicted probabilities for prescribed fire class
val_predictions_v7 <- predict(rf_model_v7_prob, data = valid_set)
prob_prescribed_val <- val_predictions_v7$predictions[, "prescribed"]

# Map probabilities to hard labels using a 0.50 decision threshold
predicted_labels_v7 <- ifelse(prob_prescribed_val >= 0.50, "prescribed", "wildfire")
predicted_labels_v7 <- factor(predicted_labels_v7, levels = c("prescribed", "wildfire"))

# --- 3. CONFUSION MATRIX & ACCURACY ---
conf_matrix_v7 <- table(Actual = valid_set$classification, Predicted = predicted_labels_v7)

cat("\n--- CONFUSION MATRIX (0.50 THRESHOLD) ---\n")
print(conf_matrix_v7)

accuracy_v7 <- sum(diag(conf_matrix_v7)) / sum(conf_matrix_v7)
cat(paste0("\nOverall Accuracy: ", round(accuracy_v7 * 100, 2), "%\n"))

# --- 4. VARIABLE IMPORTANCE ---
base_importance_v7 <- importance(rf_model_v7_prob)
base_importance_df_v7 <- data.frame(
  Variable   = names(base_importance_v7),
  Importance = as.numeric(base_importance_v7)
)
base_importance_df_v7 <- base_importance_df_v7[order(-base_importance_df_v7$Importance), ]

cat("\n--- VARIABLE IMPORTANCE ---\n")
print(base_importance_df_v7, row.names = FALSE)

# --- 5. DETAILED CLASS METRICS ---
TP <- conf_matrix_v7["wildfire", "wildfire"]     # True Wildfires
TN <- conf_matrix_v7["prescribed", "prescribed"] # True Prescribed
FP <- conf_matrix_v7["prescribed", "wildfire"]   # Prescribed misclassified as Wildfire
FN <- conf_matrix_v7["wildfire", "prescribed"]   # Wildfire misclassified as Prescribed

# Calculate Precision, Recall, and F1-Score per class
wf_recall    <- TP / (TP + FN)
wf_precision <- TP / (TP + FP)
wf_f1        <- 2 * (wf_precision * wf_recall) / (wf_precision + wf_recall)

rx_recall    <- TN / (TN + FP)
rx_precision <- TN / (TN + FN)
rx_f1        <- 2 * (rx_precision * rx_recall) / (rx_precision + rx_recall)

cat("\n--- WILDFIRE METRICS ---\n")
cat("Recall (Capture Rate):  ", round(wf_recall * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("Precision (Reliability):", round(wf_precision * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("F1-Score:               ", round(wf_f1, 4), "\n\n")

cat("--- PRESCRIBED METRICS ---\n")
cat("Recall (Capture Rate):  ", round(rx_recall * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("Precision (Reliability):", round(rx_precision * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("F1-Score:               ", round(rx_f1, 4), "\n")
```

Apply v7 to unmatched data

```{r}
unmatched_pool <- data_erc %>% 
  filter(record_match == 0)

# Count how many cells are completely blank ("") or missing (NA)
data_erc %>%
  summarise(
    blank_classification = sum(classification == "" | is.na(classification)),
    blank_ecol3          = sum(ecol3_mode == "" | is.na(ecol3_mode)),
    blank_nlcdr          = sum(nlcdr_mode == "" | is.na(nlcdr_mode))
  )

# Drop any empty ghost levels from the factor columns
unmatched_pool <- droplevels(unmatched_pool)

# Convert empty strings to NA and match training set levels structure
unmatched_pool$classification <- factor(unmatched_pool$classification, levels = levels(train_set$classification))
unmatched_pool$ecol3_mode <- factor(unmatched_pool$ecol3_mode, levels = levels(train_set$ecol3_mode))
unmatched_pool$nlcdr_mode <- factor(unmatched_pool$nlcdr_mode, levels = levels(train_set$nlcdr_mode))

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# RUN PROBABILITY PREDICTION ACROSS 1.62 MILLION ROWS
# -------------------------------------------------------------
cat("Deploying ClassiFIRE probability forest...\n")
predictions_unmatched <- predict(rf_model_v7_prob, data = unmatched_pool)

# Extract raw probabilities of being a prescribed fire and append to unmatched dataframe
unmatched_pool$prob_prescribed <- predictions_unmatched$predictions[, "prescribed"]


# -------------------------------------------------------------
# STITCH MATCHED AND UNMATCHED BACK TOGETHER
# -------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nStitching matched and unmatched pools together...\n")
sefm_classifired <- bind_rows(matched_pool, unmatched_pool)

cat("\n--- Master Dataset Stitch Verification ---\n")
cat("Total Rows:", nrow(sefm_classifired), "\n")

# Verify the NA alignment logic across the final joined dataset
print(table(Is_NA_Prob = is.na(sefm_classifired$prob_prescribed), 
            Record_Match = sefm_classifired$record_match))

#create prob_wildfire
sefm_classifired <- sefm_classifired %>%
  mutate(
    prob_wildfire = ifelse(is.na(prob_prescribed), NA_real_, 1 - prob_prescribed)
  )

#create class_prob, shows prob of class at 50%
sefm_classifired <- sefm_classifired %>%
  mutate(
    # If it's a matched record, keep it NA. 
    # Otherwise, grab the probability that matches the predicted label.
    class_prob = case_when(
      is.na(prob_prescribed) ~ NA_real_,
      class_pred_50 == "prescribed" ~ prob_prescribed,
      class_pred_50 == "wildfire"   ~ (1 - prob_prescribed)
    )
  )

# Verify a few rows to make sure the logic mapped 
sefm_classifired %>%
  filter(record_match == 0) %>%
  select(class_pred_50, prob_prescribed, class_prob) %>%
  head(10)

# Export
write.csv(sefm_classifired, "output.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
